design_gotchas.title: Unique SOT-23-3 Pinout (1=OUT, 2=IN, 3=GND) Incompatible With ALL Other SOT-23-3 LDOs in Batch
design_gotchas.detail: LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB assigns Pin 1=OUT, Pin 2=IN, Pin 3=GND. This conflicts directly with both Diodes Inc SA (AP7333-33SAG-7 / AP7313-33SAG-7: 1=IN, 2=OUT, 3=GND) AND reversed SR / AP2210N (1=GND, 2=OUT, 3=IN). Never drop LM3480 onto a standard 3-pin LDO footprint without verifying PCB net assignments.

design_gotchas.title: High 0.9 V Typ (1.2 V Max) Quasi-LDO Dropout & 2 mA Quiescent Current
design_gotchas.detail: Built with a PNP-driven NPN Darlington-like quasi-LDO pass stage (Page 10), LM3480 drops 0.9 V typ (1.2 V max) at 100 mA — making single-cell Li-Ion (3.7 V) to 3.3 V impossible and requiring >= 4.5–4.75 V input (5 V ±5% min). Its 2 mA typ (4 mA max) no-load ground current is also ~35–80,000x higher than modern CMOS LDOs.

design_gotchas.title: Severe Thermal Derating at 24 V / 30 V Input in SOT-23-3 (RθJA = 269.6 C/W)
design_gotchas.detail: Although LM3480 accepts up to 30 V operating (35 V abs max), SOT-23-3 RθJA is 269.6 °C/W (PD = 370 mW at TA = 50°C). Regulating 24 V down to 3.3 V (20.7 V drop) limits continuous load current to under 18 mA at 50°C ambient before hitting TJ = 150°C thermal limiting.

design_gotchas.title: Wide ±5% Output Tolerance & Minimum 1 mA Load Specification
design_gotchas.detail: Guaranteed output accuracy is ±5% (3.14 V to 3.46 V over -40°C to +125°C, tested over 1 mA to 100 mA), which is far looser than ±1%–±2% precision CMOS LDOs. On the upside, it stabilizes cleanly with just 0.1 uF ceramic output capacitance with no ESR restriction.

typical_use_cases: Ultra-compact 12 V / 24 V industrial bus to 3.3 V low-current (<20 mA) bias supplies replacing LM78Lxx
5 V ±5% to 3.3 V 100 mA compact bias regulator where 35 V input surge withstand is required
Post-regulator for noisy switching DC-DC rails needing minimal 0.1 uF external capacitors
High-voltage analog/control bias rail where simple 3-pin SOT-23-3 footprint and wide VIN range outweigh IQ
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB is a 100 mA, 30 V-rated (35 V abs max) fixed 3.3 V (±5%) quasi-low-dropout linear regulator in a 3-pin DBZ SOT-23-3 package with a distinctive Pin 1=OUT, Pin 2=IN, Pin 3=GND assignment. Intended as a tiny alternative to 78Lxx regulators, it operates down to 0.9 V typical (1.2 V max) dropout at 100 mA and stabilizes with just 0.1 uF input and output capacitors with no ESR limits. Engineers must account for its incompatible SOT-23-3 pinout, 2 mA typical ground current, and 269.6 °C/W RθJA thermal ceiling when stepping down from 12 V–30 V inputs.
